description: The figure presents two pie charts intended to show the distribution of outcome categories for two conditions (one chart on the left and one on the right), using a shared legend across the top; each pie chart contains four slices with percentage labels printed inside the wedges. In the left pie, the slices are approximately 68.0% (dark teal, labeled “Atomic Skill Fail” in the legend), 12.0% (medium teal, labeled “Correct”), 12.0% (very light blue/gray, labeled “Reason …” with the remainder of the label not fully visible), and 8.0% (white, label not clearly visible). In the right pie, the slices are approximately 55.0% (medium teal, corresponding to “Correct”), 21.0% (very light blue/gray, corresponding to the partially visible “Reason …” category), 14.0% (white, label not clearly visible), and 10.0% (dark teal, corresponding to “Atomic Skill Fail”). A legend is present, and neither pie shows exploded/offset slices; the wedges appear arranged with the largest segment occupying the majority of each pie rather than being strictly ordered by size.
